about: The shoreline recipe's views (VS-06, WP-BIOME): the test zone's sheltered and exposed stretches, and both in one frame. The biome ON/OFF gate is the average frame time over these three views, same session, uncapped. Views only: the core file owns the route and art_sentinels.

viewpoints.expectation: Down onto the sheltered bight west of the quay, behind the south reef, in the storm: a pocket of pale cobble at the waterline, driftwood lying along the shore above it, a few low weeds higher up, the terrain still the ground underneath. Nothing floats, nothing is a checker, nothing is a grid.

From the water off the west headland's tip, in the storm: dark broken talus blocks along the foot of the steep south face, little cobble, almost no driftwood; a harder, barer shore than the harbor view, not the same texture.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §10.4 (look); Gemini VS-06 shoreline brief §6 (exposed shore); Tools/Biomes/zones/_test.json headland_tip

viewpoints.expectation: From the water south-west of the west headland, both exposures in one frame: on the right the open south face with dark talus along its foot, on the left the inner shore by the reef causeway, sheltered by it, with a cobble pocket and driftwood. The same zone polygon, told apart only by the recipe's fetch measure; the terrain carries the shape.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §10.4; Tools/Biomes/great_lakes_rocky_shore.json exposure (fetch); Codex VS-06 brief §10 (both exposures in one frame)
